look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson seven
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 2, lesson T07, Market, Limit and Stop Orders; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: An order is an instruction
scenes.desc: An order ticket fills in side and amount; its type and price are still open; three order types appear.

scenes.name: The order book
scenes.desc: Fictional order book: asks above, bids below, the spread between; a small buy meets an ask and fills.

scenes.name: Market order
scenes.desc: A market buy for 0.01 BTC eats two ask levels; the average price 60,016 USDT is worked out.

scenes.name: Slippage
scenes.desc: The asks jump before the order arrives: expected 60,010, filled 60,100; 0.90 USDT extra on 0.01 BTC.

scenes.name: Limit order
scenes.desc: A limit buy at 59,950 rests in the book; price comes down and it fills for 599.50 USDT.

scenes.name: A limit may not fill
scenes.desc: A limit buy at 59,900 waits; price dips to 59,920 and rises away; the order stays unfilled.

scenes.name: Partial fill
scenes.desc: Only 0.004 of a 0.01 BTC limit buy fills; the remaining 0.006 keeps waiting.

scenes.name: Stop order
scenes.desc: A stop at 59,500 waits; price falls and touches the trigger; a market sell fills at 59,480.

scenes.name: Stops can slip
scenes.desc: Price gaps from above the trigger to 59,200; the stop fills there, 3 USDT worse on 0.01 BTC.

scenes.name: Side by side
scenes.desc: Market, limit and stop compared on speed, price control and fill certainty.

scenes.name: Common mistake
scenes.desc: The belief that a stop guarantees the exit price is crossed out and corrected.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and choose an order type for a scenario; the limit buy is revealed with its trade-off; waiting is also allowed.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Slippage, unfilled and partial orders, stops filling past the trigger, and the choice not to trade.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T08, stop-loss and take-profit.
